title: HomeWizard P1 Meter Instant Power Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homewizard:p1 power_w=*
| stats sum(power_w) as total_value, avg(power_w) as avg_value by phase
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks phase values by total and average instant power across HomeWizard P1 reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `power_w` values for each HomeWizard P1 reading event and review total and average instant power by phase.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total instant power.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep which phase shows the biggest instant power numbers in your HomeWizard P1 reading data.
